name: FineDNA
description: Training corpus of the Carbon-X DNA language model for all three of its stages: mid-training on genomes, transcripts, biology text, English and instruction data, then supervised fine-tuning conversations and reinforcement-learning prompts.

attributes.access: Public download from Hugging Face; the mid-training configs total about 950 GB and are meant to be streamed.
attributes.species: Eukaryotes (fungi, protozoa, plants, invertebrates, mammals, other vertebrates) from GENERator; mRNA and prokaryote genomes (GTDB and IMG/PR) from OpenGenome2
attributes.population: Mid-training: 23 configs, 514.30B tokens, of which Carbon-X read 302B by weighted sampling (DNA 55%, biology text 15%, English 20%, instruction data 10%). SFT: 203,923 conversations (230.3M tokens) in eight domains, including 57,254 variant-effect prediction rows. RL: 98,433 verifiable prompts (61.1M tokens) in eight task groups, including bioreason (19,996), vepqa (7,426) and genomeqa (14,032) prompts.
attributes.split: Training data only. Biology-text mid-training configs carry a validation split held out to track loss; the SFT and RL configs are training rows in trainer order.
attributes.scope_note: A training corpus, not an evaluation set: no result in this store is measured on it. It is recorded so that training overlap can be checked for evaluations of Carbon-X and of models trained on the same upstream data. mid_dna_mrna_splice holds 56.9 million OpenGenome2 mRNA sequences with splice and promoter context, with splice-junction markers removed.
attributes.reuse_restrictions: Apache-2.0 for FineDNA; the mid-training configs come from GENERator, OpenGenome2, FineWeb-Edu, DCLM, FinePDFs-Edu, PubMed Central, bioRxiv, Biostars and Nemotron, which keep their own licences and terms.
attributes.source_locator: finedna-20261101-source-finedna-card: stage table, Mid-training ('The mix', 'What is in it'), SFT ('Domains'), RL ('Task groups'), License

review.reviewer_note: Claude agent; no human review claimed. Extractor and reviewer were the same agent in the same session.
review.method_note: Both cards re-read at their pinned commits with SHA-256 checked; build.py asserts each quoted count and statement against the card text.
review.note: Descriptive records only; no result. Verdict in docs/reviews/2026-11-01-finedna.md.

name: Carbon-X
description: Carbon-X reads raw DNA inside a chat conversation and answers in English, predicting variant pathogenicity, classifying sequences and predicting the next bases.

attributes.access: Public weights on Hugging Face; 14.8B parameters in bfloat16, served with vLLM on a single 80 GB GPU.
attributes.training_data: FineDNA (finedna-20261101-data-finedna) for all three stages: 302B tokens of mid-training from Qwen3-14B, then SFT (HuggingFaceBio/Carbon-X-SFT) and GRPO reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. The card states that all training data was decontaminated against its five evaluation benchmarks by whole-span DNA overlap, text n-gram overlap and sequence homology search.
attributes.provenance_note: Decoder-only Transformer extended from Qwen3-14B with 5,515 DNA tokens (non-overlapping 6-mers); 40,960-token context. Built by Hugging Face, Zhongguancun Academy and the Telethon Institute of Genetics and Medicine (University of Naples Federico II). Not clinically validated; the card reports weak splice-site (29.8%) and histone-mark (34.6%) accuracy on GenomeQA.
